summary: Iteration 57 — full-stack testing of (A) Media Backup + Self-Healing system and (B) HomeMe App-Level Branding. Backend: 23/23 pytest tests passed. Frontend: all 8 Playwright checks passed (public branding endpoint, owner login, MediaHealth page renders 6 testids, AppBranding page renders 6 testids, sidebar entries + HomeMe logo/name testids, non-owner blocked with Arabic access-denied message). Critical self-heal flow verified end-to-end: upload logo → backup-now → delete from /app/uploads → GET /api/files/homeme/{file} → 200 image/png AND file restored to disk.
critical_code_review_comments: media_health.py _scan() runs full disk + DB scan on every overview/orphans/broken hit — fine for current volumes (39 files) but should be cached or paginated once uploads grow >10k files.
app_branding.py PUT validates hex via regex `^#(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8})$` which permits 3, 5 and 7-char hex (technically invalid CSS for 5 and 7). Consider tightening to {3,4,6,8} if needed.
Self-heal in serve_subdir_file imports services.media_backup inside the function on every miss — acceptable since path is rarely hit, but a module-level import would be cleaner.
take_snapshot() retention prune iterates BACKUP_ROOT but ignores non-date dirs silently — OK; just noting that any manual files placed there will be skipped.
DB_REFS list in media_health.py is hand-maintained; if a new collection adds image fields it will silently NOT be tracked. Consider a registry pattern.
